title: Sign-out scope gate rejects the shared auth package's local OAuth signOut
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; guard failure is independent of sign-in
preconditions: Run the exact-main CI candidate at source associated with GitHub Actions run 38251459600 after the @ai-matrx/auth package migration.
Run the required pnpm check:signout-scope gate.
reproduction: Observe exact-main CI run 38251459600 fail in pnpm check:signout-scope at src/lib/auth/flow.ts oauth.signOut().
The migrated shared-package signOut is scoped to the local OAuth client; the guard currently treats that call as unscoped.
An independent final review reproduced a valid block-comment-prefixed bare or global GoTrue URL that the prior guard skipped; the comment-aware repair now detects both.
expected: The guard accepts the shared auth package's local-scope signOut while continuing to reject genuine unscoped sign-out paths; required CI remains green.
actual: Required exact-main CI fails on a local-scope OAuth signOut call after the auth package migration, blocking infrastructure validation. No product sign-out defect has been established.
cause: The original guard did not recognize the migrated shared auth package's local OAuth client scope. Its first repair skipped entire lines beginning with comments, permitting executable unscoped logout URLs after a block comment.
severity: S2: a required release/CI guard blocks validation; no product behavior impact established
priority: P0: restore a sound required gate before relying on release-candidate validation
evidence: Combined unit suite receipt owner-vitest-20261012-1329 passed at 619ebf923d4867b4a4e1fbeca74092b25b2b6ea1; it does not replace pnpm check:signout-scope or review of guard bypass resistance.
docs/stabilization/reports/d0206-final-guard-peer-20261012.json: independent review reproduced the block-comment bypass in the prior repair.
docs/stabilization/reports/d0206-comment-repair-peer-20261012.json: fresh independent review passed the reported bypass and 11 surrounding lexer probes.
https://github.com/armanisadeghi/matrx-extend/actions/runs/38266455996: exact-source 6522427bb CI sign-out scope gate and its self-test completed successfully.
next_action: Keep live extension sign-out behavior as a separate unverified product case. Address unrelated remaining CI/release gates without reopening this scope-guard defect unless its reproduction returns.
